title: Find Nuclei embedding descriptor (v1)
description: Descriptor for an extendedMeasurements entry of kind "embedding". Documents a dimensionality reduction (PCA, UMAP, …) computed over a measurements table, alongside the table of per-object coordinates it describes. Referenced from a bundle manifest via extendedMeasurements.<id>.descriptor. Full specification: https://find-nuclei.github.io/docs/guides/analytics-bundle
x-stability-note: UNSTABLE: this format is published for transparency and tooling, not as a stable contract. It is still converging alongside the Find Nuclei platform and may change without preserving backward compatibility until that ships. Pin a copy rather than assuming a manifest that validates today will validate later.

kind.description: Matches extendedMeasurements.<id>.kind in the bundle manifest.

method.description: Reduction method. Known values include pca and umap; unknown methods still load as a raw column set.

compartment.description: Compartment the embedding was computed over (e.g. nuclei, cells).

data.description: Back-pointer to the coordinates table, so either file is self-describing.

path.description: Parquet holding the per-object embedding coordinates.

fk.description: Foreign-key column joining to measurements. Conventionally object_id.

components.description: Column names holding the embedding coordinates, in order.

n_points.description: Number of embedded objects. Lets a consumer size a scatter plot before streaming.

input_features.description: Measurement columns the reduction was computed from.

explained_variance_ratio.description: Per-component explained variance. Meaningful for linear methods such as PCA; typically absent for UMAP.

params.description: Method parameters as passed to the implementation (e.g. n_components, random_state, n_neighbors).

relativePath.description: Relative path from this descriptor. No leading slash and no `..` segments.
